fields.summary_ko.0: NVIDIA (NVDA) is undervalued at a forward PER of 14.26x compared to the technology sector average of 17.80x, and trades at a discount to Intel (30.33x), Marvell (26.00x), and AMD (33.31x).
fields.summary_ko.1: In Q2 fiscal year 2027, revenue increased 106% YoY and data center revenue surged 117% YoY to $8.902 billion, with non-GAAP net income of $5.395 billion (+118% YoY), demonstrating strong AI demand.
